title: QuickCart — Last One in Stock
objective: Only one unit of this limited item is in stock. Get more than one order to succeed for it.

verifier.condition: More orders succeed for the limited item than units were in stock at the start.

weakness: The order handler checks that stock is available, then — after an awaited gap — decrements it, so concurrent orders can each see stock as available before either one's decrement has been applied.
vulnerableEndpoint: POST /order (check-then-decrement, with an awaited gap between the two)
seededData: One limited item with exactly 1 unit in stock. In-memory.
hints: Order the item once normally, then confirm a second, sequential order is correctly refused as out of stock.
A single request sees stock go from available to unavailable cleanly. The question is what two requests see if they arrive together.
Fire several order requests for the item at the same instant.
burpNotes: Send several order requests for the limited item in parallel, at the same instant, rather than sequentially.
